items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: There’s a friend of mine, Harry Blazer, that has a home studio there

ctx.x: What’s coming up in the near future for you?

We’re going to Montana tomorrow. And I have a concert there. I’m doing some recording there with some friends. There’s a friend of mine, Harry Blazer, that has a home studio there, and playing with another friend, a great bass player, Abraham Laboriel, and Ron Feuer, and we’re doing some recording up there of some music of ours and we’re doing a clinic and a concert for the community in Whitefish and Kalispell, that area. And then we go from there back to L.A. and I have a concert in Santa Barbara with Charlie…
Istanbul. And then around Germany and stuff. And it just goes on like that. Then I come back and get ready for the next tour. So it’s very busy.
